question: On uniform growth U(n) (n = 100, 200, 400) and the tree control, how much of a base does the value of a co-knotted pair or a knot decide, how much of it is ties of its members, local propagation or search, and how does it spread in steps, at half, three quarters and the last base?

definitions.samples: 20 runs each (growth seed 50000 + run, reading seed 60000 + run) from fates.py pinned by sha256
definitions.readings: as in census.py: forced fraction, beyond ties, by propagation, reach, shell profile, for 20 pairs and 20 knots per base, the pattern forcing the most

public_inputs.code: census.py (sha256 d0faa2e92693391250bac8f72c31effa850c871968b6fdb1f4cb918244af4219) beside this file; pysat; 8 workers. fates.py of RANDOM-FATES-20261112-001A-E001, sha256 72d3571ed66dddaa6c517b3ce29ce14ae72c008c025669e2ef071b77b73eba35, imported read-only.
public_inputs.run: census.py from the repository root (one run); output in artifacts/COMMON-FOLD-20261112-001B/COMMON-FOLD-20261112-001B-E001_finite_influence/.

forbidden_inputs: Changing seeds, weightings, families, windows, sets or predictions after seeing results
primary_observable: Per process, n and stage: means of forced fraction, beyond ties, by propagation, reach, profile

predictions.B1: check: tree control pair reach <= 1 and knot patterns force nothing
predictions.B2: half and three quarters: mean pair forced fraction <= 2% for every n
predictions.B3: last base: mean pair forced fraction >= 50% for n = 100, 200, 400
predictions.B4: last base: mean pair fraction beyond ties <= 5% and by propagation <= 5%

decision_rules.B2-B4 hold: influence local until the end, global at the last base, made of ties found by search
decision_rules.B3 fails at some n: the last base's influence shrinks with size
decision_rules.B4 fails: pairs decide beyond ties, or the influence propagates locally

stop_rule: One run; report and hand off to the referee thread.
runtime: About 10 to 30 minutes on 8 workers; registered in docs/LONG_RUNNING.md; systemd-run --user -p MemoryMax=16G -p MemorySwapMax=0.
